sources.note: 'Stress is not phonemic. Two factors control the distribution of stress within the word: (1) Tone: the stress is born by the syllable with the highest tone. (2) Linear position in the word: out of several syllables with the same height of tone the one nearest to the end of the word bears the stress.' -- Legbo, not Lubila.
